question: Ratio of days having negative gdp growth to total days
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gdp_growth < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE gdp_growth < 0;
answer: The ratio of days with negative GDP growth to total days is 1.0. This means that out of all the days in the dataset, 100% of them experienced negative GDP growth.
